source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
symbol: misc(shell)
    run-on-projects: []
    run:
        mach: >
            commlint -v -l shellcheck -f treeherder
            -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
            comm/*
    optimization:
        skip-unless-mozlint: shellcheck.yml

stylelint:
    description: CSS lint check
    treeherder:
        symbol: stylelint
    run:
        using: run-task
        cwd: '{checkout}'
        command: >
            cp -r $MOZ_FETCHES_DIR/node_modules node_modules &&
            ln -s ../tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-mozilla node_modules &&
            ln -s ../tools/lint/eslint/eslint-plugin-spidermonkey-js node_modules &&
            ./mach commlint -v -l stylelint -f treeherder
            -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
            comm
    optimization:
        skip-unless-mozlint: stylelint.yml
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-node
            - node-modules
